metrics.label: COMPOSITE RECOVERY
metrics.tip: Daily composite recovery score combining multiple data sources. Weighted formula: WHOOP Recovery × 0.4 + Garmin Body Battery × 0.3 + 8Sleep Score × 0.2 + Inverse Stress × 0.1. Provides a unified readiness score across platforms.

metrics.label: 7D AVG RECOVERY
metrics.tip: 7-day rolling average of composite recovery scores. Calculated as: (WHOOP Recovery × 0.4 + Garmin Body Battery × 0.3 + 8Sleep Score × 0.2 + (100 - Stress) × 0.1) averaged over 7 days. Smooths daily fluctuations to show baseline trend.

metrics.label: TREND
metrics.tip: Direction of recovery trend over recent days. Calculated from rate of change in composite recovery. STABLE = minimal change, IMPROVING = consistent upward trend, DETERIORATING = consistent downward trend. Helps identify momentum vs single-day values.

blocks.title: 1. Recovery Trends (Multi-Source)
blocks.caption: This enhanced dual-source recovery graph overlays WHOOP Recovery (blue circles) and 8Sleep Fitness Score (purple squares) with color-coded threshold zones: green (>60% - good recovery), yellow (30-60% - moderate), and red (<30% - critical stress). Orange markers (▼) at the bottom indicate "away from home" periods when 8Sleep data is unavailable. Gaps in the lines represent missing data rather than interpolated values, providing an accurate view of your recovery patterns across multiple tracking platforms.

blocks.title: 2. Strength Benchmark (Monday)

blocks.title: 3. Cardio Intensity (Distance vs Strain)

blocks.title: 4. Weekly Load Progression
blocks.caption: This graph shows your total training load, combining lifting volume and running distance, aggregated week-over-week. It helps in assessing your long-term training progression and avoiding overtraining.

blocks.title: 5. Fueling vs Output
blocks.caption: This chart compares your daily caloric intake (consumed) with your estimated caloric expenditure (burned) over the past 14 days, offering insights into your energy balance for recovery and performance.

blocks.title: 6. Sleep Debt Trends
blocks.caption: This chart tracks your sleep debt over time using WHOOP, Garmin, and 8Sleep metrics, helping identify cumulative recovery deficits and sleep consistency patterns.
